description.zh:
使用JT/T 808协议通信时，服务端向指定设备发送消息的类型。可取值：

- **0**：GNSS模块详细定位数据。
- **11**：道路运输证IC卡信息。
- **65**：串口1透传。
- **66**：串口2透传。
- **240**~**255**：用户自定义透传。

物联网平台支持的JT/T 808协议详细使用说明，请参见[JT/T 808协议云网关概述](~~474256~~)。
description.en:
The message type used when the server sends a message to the specified device over the JT/T 808 protocol. Valid values:  

- **0**: Detailed GNSS module positioning data.  
- **11**: Road transport license IC card information.  
- **65**: Pass-through via serial port 1.  
- **66**: Pass-through via serial port 2.  
- **240**–**255**: Custom pass-through defined by the user.  

For detailed instructions on using the JT/T 808 protocol supported by IoT Platform, see [Overview of JT/T 808 Protocol Cloud Gateway](~~474256~~).

description.zh: 要接收消息的设备名称。
description.en: The name of the device that receives the request.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

description.zh: 要发送的消息内容经过Base64编码得到的字符串格式数据，例如`dGhpcyBpcyBhbiBleGFtcGxl`。
description.en: The string that is obtained by performing Base64 encoding on the message. Example: `dGhpcyBpcyBhbiBleGFtcGxl`.

description.zh: 等待设备回复消息的时间，单位是毫秒，取值范围是1,000 ~8,000。
description.en: The timeout period of a response. Unit: milliseconds. Valid values: 1000 to 8000.

description.zh:
使用自定义的RRPC相关Topic。需要设备端配合使用，请参见设备端开发[自定义Topic](~~90570~~)。
不传入此参数，则使用系统默认的RRPC Topic。
description.en:
The custom revert-RPC (RRPC) topic. Before you can use a custom RRPC topic, you must configure the device. For more information, see [Use custom topics](~~90570~~).

If you do not configure this parameter, the default RRPC topic is used.

title.en: Send a Request Message to a Device

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
调用该接口后，如果设备端未在设置的超时时间（**Timeout**）内做出反馈，即使设备收到了消息，云端也视消息为发送失败。

## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为1000。

  > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To  
After you invoke this API, if the device does not respond within the configured **Timeout** period, IoT Platform considers the message as failed to send—even if the device has received the message.

## QPS Limits

A single Alibaba Cloud account can make up to 1000 queries per second (QPS) when calling this API.

  > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot rrpc --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key aldfeSe0000 --device-name device1 --timeout 1000 --content-type 240 --request-base64-byte dGhpcyBpcyBhbiBleGFtcGxl --topic /a1uZfYb0000/A_Vol0000/user/update --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot RRpc --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --ContentType 240 --Timeout 1000 --Topic '/a1uZfYb0000/A_Vol0000/user/update' --ProductKey aldfeSe0000 --RequestBase64Byte dGhpcyBpcyBhbiBleGFtcGxl --DeviceName device1
